title: Tensor-normalized large point scalar comparisons satisfy the cocone tower equation

from.place: Common-stage point-fibre construction: the two stageScalar comparisons must respect further coefficient extension before descent to representative classes

statement: Fix a finite-field datum D=(p,a,q,k_0,k) [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime l different from p and an algebraic closure Ω of Q_l, in a universe independent of Spec(k). For each finite intermediate field E of Ω, let C_E=D^b_c(Spec(k),Shrink(E)) be the prescribed rational constructible category and let S_{L/E}, a_{M,L,E}:S_{M/L} S_{L/E} ≅ S_{M/E} be its prescribed scalar transitions and associators [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Put V_E(K)=Ω tensor_{Shrink(E)} H^0(Fib_E(K)), using the specified rational point fibre [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point] and ordinary coefficient cohomology [def-weil-coefficient-cohomology-modules]. The coefficient map e_E:Shrink(E)→Ω is the Shrink algebra equivalence followed by the actual subfield inclusion. Let sigma_{L/E,K}:H^0(Fib_L(S_{L/E}K)) ≅ L_small tensor_{E_small} H^0(Fib_E(K)) be H^0 of the prescribed rational point-fibre scalar comparison followed by the canonical field cohomology comparison. Define c_{L/E}:V_L S_{L/E} ≅ V_E as the unique natural isomorphism sending a tensor sigma^{-1}(b tensor v) to a e_L(b) tensor v. Then for every E⊆L⊆M, including repeated fields, and K∈C_E, the two maps V_M(S_{M/L}S_{L/E}K)→V_E(K) agree: V_M(a_{M,L,E,K}) followed by c_{M/E,K} equals c_{M/L,S_{L/E}K} followed by c_{L/E,K}. This asserts a local scalar coherence equality only; it does not assert existence of a functor on the common-stage quotient.

source.place: The derived stalk and its finite-dimensional cohomology, with coefficient-limit convention of Weil II (1.1.1)d); the normalized sections/scalar tower and cohomology/tensor tower provide the explicit agent-written calculation.

proof.text: The specified rational point-fibre comparison is uniquely normalized by the integral sections scalar comparison. The latter satisfies the tower equation with the completed rational source associator and ordinary target tensor associator. Transport through the fixed size equivalences and rationalization: equality is detected by the fully faithful size lift, and rational maps are generated by integral maps tensored with scalars. Thus the normalized rational comparison has the same tower equation for the actual Shrink coefficient inclusions.

Apply H^0 to that equation. Naturality and fieldDerivedHomologyIso_tower identify the composite of its cohomology comparisons with the direct comparison, keeping the target module tensor associator. The source stageSystem associator is the prescribed scalarAssociator transported by the coefficientInclusion composition equality. The embedding maps compose because the Shrink equivalences cancel.

Extend to Ω. Precompose with the scalar extension of the inverse nested H^0 comparisons, an isomorphism. Pure nested tensors a tensor(c tensor(b tensor v)) generate. Each route flattens it to (a e_M(c) e_L(b)) tensor v; compatibility of embeddings and associativity of multiplication identify the two outputs. Tensor induction and inverse cancellation give equality. The uniquely normalized c maps are precisely stageScalar. Repeated fields obey the same formulas and require no extra hypothesis.

theorem stageScalar_tower
    {E L M : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω} (h : E ≤ L) (k : L ≤ M)
    (K : GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Stage l Ω (Spec (.of D.k)) E) :
    (stageFibre D l hl Ω M).map
        (((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.stageSystem l Ω
          (Spec (.of D.k))).assoc h k).hom.app K) ≫
        (stageScalar D l hl Ω (h.trans k)).hom.app K =
      (stageScalar D l hl Ω k).hom.app
          (((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.stageSystem l Ω
            (Spec (.of D.k))).T h).obj K) ≫
        (stageScalar D l hl Ω h).hom.app K
